USBP agents stopped a Paisas gang member tied to the Gulf Cartel after he illegally crossed the border. He tried to sneak in this country with fake documents—including a bogus Social Security card and counterfeit green card. Now he is being prosecuted for illegal reentry and fraud. Deportation is next.
 
Apprehended. Prosecuted. Deported. Zero leniency. Zero exceptions.
